## Problem and result

Describe the user-visible problem and the behavior after this change.

## Scope

List the applications or contracts affected. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

Record commands and outcomes, device/browser checks, and anything not run.

## Release considerations

Describe configuration, migrations, rollout/rollback requirements and known limitations.
For screenshots or logs, remove personal data and private tokens.
